title: .NET 10 Web API Backend Foundation and Infrastructure
acceptance_criteria: .NET 10 Web API project configured with Minimal APIs and C# 13.
Entity Framework Core DbContext and entities matching 07-data-model.md with PostgreSQL xmin concurrency token.
Global RFC 9457 ProblemDetails factory and exception handling middleware supporting custom errorCode and extensions.
Idempotency middleware utilizing Redis / EF Core idempotency store.
Built-in SlidingWindowRateLimiter middleware and OpenAPI/Swagger generator setup.
